Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BROACH, MOORE TYPE, FOR HIP PROSTHESIS 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Moore type broach used for hip 
prosthesis in orthopaedic surgery, 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



\ 



DETACHABLE 
BAR

Al! dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 BROACH, MOORE TYPE, FOR HIP PROSTHESIS 

2.1 Deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3 S Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 3CCM3 of IS : 6603-1972 ' Specification for 

stainless steel bars and flats \ 

3.1 The material for the detachable bar shall be the same as that for broach. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The cutting edges of the broach shall be sharp and free from nicks, 
burrs and waviness. 

4.1 The broach shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The broach shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 450 to 
500 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance — The broach shall be made to scrape in the upper end of medullary femer bone of 
a fully grown sheep or goat 20 times. The performance of the instrument shall be smooth and 
easy. The teeth of the broach shall not get blunt or damaged after the test. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — The instrument shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as 
mentioned in IS : 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

7 S Marking — The broach shall be marked with manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- 
mark and the words ' Stainless steel '. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Each broach shall be wrapped in polyethylene bags and then packed in cartons, 
broach may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
